definition.probe: Q1 linear probe path (exp002 probes.linear_fit_predict): fitted on encoder tokens (patch mean) of the probe-training rows, frames 0..11, label of the same frame; applied unchanged to encoder tokens of frame k, persistence (frame t copied) and the rollout latent of step k
definition.labels: mask_centroid / mask_bbox_center: cloth mask (002 HSV rule) of the cached 224x224 frame, coordinates / 224, frames with an empty mask are excluded from fit and evaluation; cum_action_*: sum of the raw actions with index < 5*frame for gripper 1 (dims dx1 dy1 dz1) and gripper 2 (dx2 dy2 dz2) = commanded displacement since frame 0 (NOT a measured gripper position; initial position not in the data fields read)
definition.r2: role pooled R2 (1 - SSE/SST); r2_within_level|all: R2 after removing level means of label and prediction (002 stats.r2_within_from_level_sums)
